members.title: Members
members.description: Create backend accounts for this tenant. A tenant admin manages the tenant's own instances and resources; a tenant member is read-only.
members.empty: This tenant has no members yet
members.emptyHint: Create a tenant admin account so the customer can sign in to their own console.

createDialog.title: Add member
createDialog.description: Hand the initial password to the customer over a secure channel and ask them to change it after the first sign-in.
createDialog.passwordHelper: At least 12 characters; it will not be shown again
createDialog.passwordTooShort: The initial password needs at least 12 characters
createDialog.roleAdminHint: Tenant admin: manages this tenant's instances and resources
createDialog.roleTenantAdminOnlyUserHint: Tenant admins can only create read-only members. To add another admin, contact your service provider.

removeDialog.title: Remove member
removeDialog.description: "{{username}}" will no longer be able to sign in to this tenant's console.

team.title: My Team
team.subtitle: Create read-only console accounts for your team; to add another admin, contact your service provider. The initial password is shown only once.
team.readOnlyBanner: You are signed in as a tenant member: the member list is read-only for you.
team.noTenant: This account is not bound to any tenant, so team members cannot be managed. Please contact your service provider.
team.platformTitle: This is the tenant self-service page
team.platformHint: To manage a customer's members, open that tenant from Tenants — there you can also edit customer details, suspend the tenant and assign instances.

instances.title: Instance assignment
instances.emptyHint: Create an instance first, then come back to assign ownership.
instances.ownedByOtherHint: Assigned to another tenant; unbind it there first
instances.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, key or account
instances.selectAllHint: Select/clear all instances in the current filter
instances.noResultsHint: Adjust the search term or ownership filter and try again.

transfer.title: Confirm instance ownership changes
transfer.description: Memory, summaries, worldbooks and affection follow the instance, so the new owner can see them on the memory and worldbook pages. Memories in workspaces stay with the workspace and are not affected.
transfer.deletePluginSettingsLabel: Also delete the plugin settings of these instances
transfer.deletePluginSettingsHint: Plugin switches on the instance and its channels, and plugin settings filled in just for the instance (API keys and the like), belong to the previous owner, so they are deleted with the transfer by default; clear the checkbox to let them follow the instances, where the new tenant can see and change them.
transfer.deleteConfigOverridesLabel: Also delete the config overrides of these instances
transfer.deleteConfigOverridesHint: Settings changed just for the instance or its channels (alert webhook, chosen model groups, prompts, output filter word lists and so on) were set by the previous owner, so they are deleted with the transfer by default; clear the checkbox to let them follow the instances.
transfer.deleteSshCredentialsLabel: Also delete server credentials registered by users on these instances
transfer.deleteSshCredentialsHint: Credentials are keys into someone else's home. They are deleted with the transfer by default; clear the checkbox to let them follow the instances to the new tenant.
transfer.mailAndEmotionLine: {{mailboxes}} own mailbox(es) · {{prefs}} mail preference(s) · {{emotions}} collected sticker(s)
transfer.deleteInstanceMailboxesLabel: Also delete the mailboxes these instances added themselves
transfer.deleteInstanceMailboxesHint: They are the previous owner's inboxes (password resets, codes, bills), so they are deleted with the transfer by default, together with their mail and attachments; clear the checkbox to let them follow the instances. Either way, platform mailboxes shared with these instances by name stop being shared and unsent festival mail is voided. Collected stickers follow the instances; mail preferences follow "also clear memory".
transfer.inGroup: Will be removed from its instance group
transfer.channelQuotaCleared: Saving clears the channel quota and pause message the previous tenant set on this instance ({{count}} place(s)); the checkbox below does not affect it
transfer.clearLabel: Also clear memory, worldbooks and affection for these instances
transfer.clearWarning: This permanently deletes the domain memory, channel summaries, prompt details, worldbooks and own-domain affection of the instances above. It cannot be undone. Memory in workspaces is not deleted.
transfer.clearedSuccess: Saved and cleared memory, worldbooks and affection for {{count}} instance(s)

modelGroups.searchPlaceholder: Search by group or model name

modelGroups.ownershipTenantHint: Your own API; you maintain these credentials yourself
modelGroups.emptyHint: Create a model group to connect your own API.
modelGroups.noResultsHint: Adjust the search term or ownership filter and try again.
modelGroups.readOnlyTooltip: Platform model groups are read-only; contact the platform owner for changes
modelGroups.readOnlyRoleTooltip: Your role is read-only and cannot modify model groups
modelGroups.credentialHiddenTooltip: This is a mask, not the real key. Platform credentials are never handed to tenants.

editDialog.name: Group name
editDialog.apiKeyHiddenHelper: This is a mask, not the real key; saving keeps the existing credential untouched.
editDialog.apiKeyKeepHelper: Leave it untouched to keep the current credential; type a new value to replace it.
editDialog.apiKeyMaskLike: That is a row of mask characters, not a valid credential. Leave the field untouched to keep the current one.

deleteDialog.description: After deleting "{{name}}", configurations using it lose their model source. This cannot be undone.
